lines.zh: : {i}你知道{/i}？你怎么知道的？Makoto 告诉你的？

lines.en: : No. The...school. The hospital had to notify them and they called me. Either way, I know. So there’s no need to get into the details.
lines.zh: : 不是。是……学校。医院得通知他们，他们就打给我了。不管怎样，我知道了。所以细节就不用说了。

lines.en: scene makimikudicks30
: Hm...yeah. I imagine you {i}would{/i} be uncomfortable talking about this if you know the gist of what happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也是。既然你已经知道大概发生了什么，聊这个确实{i}会{/i}让你不自在。

lines.en: Yes, that is exactly why I am uncomfortable right now.
lines.zh: 对，这正是我现在不自在的原因。

lines.en: : You get why I’m worried though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过你明白我为什么担心吧？

lines.en: : It was one thing when I thought Makoto was becoming {i}active...{/i}and she’s light years more mature than Miku is. Like, that girl still thinks “missionary” is a traveling nun.
lines.zh: : 我以为 Makoto 开始{i}活跃起来{/i}是一回事……可她比 Miku 成熟不知道多少光年。就比如，那丫头到现在还以为「传教士」是个到处跑的修女。

lines.en: : Combine that with this newfound interest in the shop and...I don’t know. Maybe I’m overreacting. I just feel responsible for her. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 再加上她突然对店里的东西来了兴趣……我也不知道。也许是我反应过度。我只是觉得对她有责任。就这样。

lines.en: : Yeah. You seem even more motherly with her than you do with Makoto sometimes.
lines.zh: : 嗯。有时候你对她比对 Makoto 还更像个母亲。

lines.en: : Makoto doesn’t need me. She was born smart and had her dad to look up to for most of her life. Miku had me.
lines.zh: : Makoto 不需要我。她天生聪明，大半辈子还有她爸可以仰望。Miku 只有我。

lines.en: : Yeah, I...guess you {i}have{/i} been her guardian this whole time, technically.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……想来严格说，你{i}一直{/i}是她的监护人。

lines.en: : There was a little back and forth at first...but she’s been under our wing for a while, yeah. It never felt like she really considered herself a part of the family though, which...
lines.zh: : 一开始来回折腾过一阵子……不过她在我们羽翼下也待了挺久了，嗯。只是我总觉得她从来没真正把自己当成这个家的一分子，这……

lines.en: : I don’t know. I do see her as my daughter too. And I’ve talked to her about sex, but...it’s hard to make Miku...{i}understand{/i} things at times.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我也确实把她当女儿看。我也跟她谈过性，但是……有时候很难让 Miku……{i}明白{/i}一些事。

lines.en: : She’s one of those girls who learns better by {i}doing.{/i} And with something like {i}this,{/i} you’d obviously  see why that would be a problem.
lines.zh: : 她是那种{i}动手{/i}比听讲学得更快的女孩。碰上{i}这种{/i}事，你显然明白为什么会是个问题。

lines.en: : Yeah...sounds rough.
lines.zh: : 嗯……听起来是挺难的。

lines.en: scene makimikudicks31
: It is. You’ll help me keep an eye on her though, right?
lines.zh: : 是挺难的。不过你会帮我盯着她点，对吧？

lines.en: : Not sure I can help much without going back to school, Maki.
lines.zh: : 不回学校的话，我怕帮不上什么忙，Maki。

lines.en: : Maybe...go back to school then? If Makoto got over her hump, I’m sure you can too.
lines.zh: : 那……就回学校去呗？既然 Makoto 都能迈过那道坎，我相信你也可以。

lines.en: : Makoto’s more mature than {i}me{/i} as well. It’s not just Miku she has the jump on.
lines.zh: : Makoto 比{i}我{/i}也成熟。她领先的可不止 Miku 一个。

lines.en: : Guess she’s got all of us beat then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那看来她是把我们全给比下去了，是吧？

lines.en: scene makimikudicks32
: It’s kind of crazy when I, like...really think about it.
lines.zh: : 我……真的认真想想的时候，还挺疯的。

lines.en: : I don’t know if times have just changed or something but, when {i}I{/i} was their age, boys were one of the last things on my mind.
lines.zh: : 我不知道是不是时代变了还是怎么的，反正{i}我{/i}在她们那个年纪的时候，男生是我最不会去想的东西之一。

lines.en: : And I get that there comes a time in every mother’s life when she needs to just sort of...let her children take the reins and figure things out on their own...but {i}already?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我也明白，每个母亲总有那么一刻需要……放手让孩子自己掌舵、自己摸索……可是{i}这么快就{/i}？

lines.en: : Do you think it’s {i}my{/i} fault? For...putting them in a situation where sex is so...normalized? Because, when I was growing up, my mom was way more traditional. Having someone like me-
lines.zh: : 你觉得是{i}我{/i}的错吗？因为……把她们放进了一个性被这么……常态化的环境里？因为我小时候，我妈可传统多了。有我这么一个——

lines.en: : Don’t...blame yourself, Maki. You’re doing everything you can.
lines.zh: : 别……别怪自己，Maki。你已经竭尽全力了。

lines.en: scene makimikudicks33
: Yeah...I guess so. I think I’ll always feel somewhat responsible, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧。不过我想我这辈子多少都会觉得有责任。

lines.en: scene makimikudicks34
: The world a child is brought up in...does a lot to determine who they are and...how they wind up.
lines.zh: : 一个孩子成长的世界……在很大程度上决定了他们是谁，以及……他们最后变成什么样。

lines.en: : I’ve been talking to Sara about it lately...trying to get better and...you know. Stuff like that. And I’m sure you get it since things have been changing in your relationship with Ami lately. It’s just tough.
lines.zh: : 我最近一直在跟 Sara 聊这件事……想让自己好一点，还有……你知道的。诸如此类。我相信你懂，毕竟你和 Ami 的关系最近也在变。就是挺难的。

lines.en: : What do you think, Aki-kun? Imagine you’d have wound up any different without me around?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，Aki 君？你想想看，要是没有我在身边，你会变成别的样子吗？

lines.en: : Do you {i}blame{/i} me for the way you are? Or do you think there’s a little more to it than that?
lines.zh: : 你现在这副样子，要{i}怪{/i}我吗？还是说，你觉得事情没那么简单？

lines.en: : Because I’ve watched what you’ve done to {i}both{/i} of her little girls. Maybe even {i}felt{/i} it. But the point remains — wouldn’t it be easier to just blame {i}her{/i} for that?
lines.zh: : 因为我看着你对她{i}那两个{/i}小姑娘做过的事。说不定还{i}感受{/i}过。但重点依然是——把这些都怪到{i}她{/i}头上，不是更省事吗？

lines.en: I have to stay quiet...
lines.zh: 我得保持沉默……

lines.en: {i}I have to stay quiet.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我得保持沉默。{/i}

lines.en: scene makimikudicks35
: It’s actually kind of funny how late I lost my virginity when you look at how I ended up. Haruka too. We’re both extreme degenerates now.
lines.zh: : 看看我现在变成什么样，再想想我破处有多晚，其实还挺好笑的。Haruka 也是。现在我俩都是彻头彻尾的变态了。

lines.en: : Just kind of assumed it would be the same for Makoto and Miku.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为 Makoto 和 Miku 也会一样。

lines.en: : Aki-kuuuuuun~
lines.zh: : Aki——君～

lines.en: : Your friend is going to think she’s boring you if just let her ramble on without adding anything to the conversatiooooon~
lines.zh: : 你要是一直就这么让她自顾自地说、自己一句也不搭，你朋友会以为她让你觉得无聊了呢～

lines.en: Stay...
lines.zh: 保持……

lines.en: Quiet...
lines.zh: 沉默……

lines.en: scene makimikudicks36
: How old were you when you had your first time, Akira? If you don’t mind me asking.
lines.zh: : 你第一次的时候多大，Akira？不介意我问吧。

lines.en: : {i}Booooom{/i} goes the dynamite. You {i}love{/i} opening up about this, don’t you? Let her have it. Let’s see the look on her face when your deepest, {i}darkest{/i} secret is unveiled.
lines.zh: : {i}轰——{/i}炸药炸了。你{i}最爱{/i}聊这个了，不是吗？告诉她吧。让我们看看，当你最深沉、{i}最黑暗{/i}的秘密被揭开来时，她脸上会是什么表情。

lines.en: : Like, maybe you’d be better than me at dealing with this if you know what it’s like to be in high school when-
lines.zh: : 比如，要是你知道自己还在上高中时就——那你可能比我更擅长应付这种事。

lines.en: scene makimikudicks37
: {i}Come onnnnnn~{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}来嘛嘛嘛～{/i}

lines.en: : So what if she gets mad at a ghost? Finding out you were such an early bloomer might lessen the blow when she finds out you’re porking her little girl.
lines.zh: : 她生一个鬼的气又怎样？知道你原来发育得这么早，说不定等她发现你在搞她的小女儿时，打击还能小一点。

lines.en: scene makimikudicks38
: Akira?...
lines.zh: : Akira？……

lines.en: : Aki-kuuuuun?
lines.zh: : Aki——君～？

lines.en: scene makimikudicks39
: Why don’t we go for a drive?
lines.zh: : 要不我们开车出去兜一圈？

lines.en: : Nooooo, I hate cars! I have such bad luck with them!
lines.zh: : 不要啊，我讨厌车！我跟车的八字太不合了！

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Save your excuses. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 借口省省吧。走。

lines.en: scene black
: We could also just...talk about something else or-
lines.zh: : 我们也可以……聊点别的，或者——

lines.en: : Or not at all! I just want to go for a drive and think you’d make a good passenger princess.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆什么都别聊！我就是想开车出去兜兜风，而且觉得你会是个很称职的副驾公主。

lines.en: : A...what?
lines.zh: : 什么……公主？

lines.en: : Ughhhh! I’ll just meet you guys there. Bye bye, Aki-kun!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！那我就直接在那儿跟你们碰头吧。拜拜，Aki 君！
